_comment: Tier-2 for fourc::particle_sph#11. Dropping TEMPERATUREEVALUATION while a result test still asks for QUANTITY 'temperature' produces "state 'temperature' not found in container!" -- and it produces it at the END: the whole time loop runs first (NOMODULE_RAN_THE_WHOLE_LOOP=yes, counted from the TIME: lines) and nothing at setup mentions temperature or thermal at all (NOMODULE_SETUP_DIAGNOSTICS=0, measured on the log prefix BEFORE the first TIME: line, not on the whole file).
